title: Affine étale model arrow descent
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder and $D : I^{op} \to \mathrm{Scheme}$ a diagram of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes with affine transitions [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-affine-morphism, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $c$ be a limiting cone. Suppose functors $v_i : \mathrm{FullAffineEtale}(D_i) \to \mathrm{FullAffineEtale}(c.pt)$ and natural transformations $q_i$ on underlying schemes have pullback squares over the cone projections [def-weil-pbc-full-affine-etale-site, def-pc-fibre-product]. Fix a stage $i$, an affine étale target $A_i$, a family $B_{i,a}$ indexed by $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, and arrows $g_a : v_i(B_{i,a}) \to v_i(A_i)$. There exist $j \ge i$, arrows $f_{j,a}$ between the canonical affine étale base changes of $B_{i,a}$ and $A_i$ to $D_j$ [lem-weil-pbc-affine-etale-site-base-change], and isomorphisms $t$ and $s_a$ from their $v_j$-images to the original $v_i$-images, with $v_j(f_{j,a}) \circ t = s_a \circ g_a$ in Lean composition order. The family may be empty.

proof.text: Identify the source v-images with their canonical pullbacks using the inverses of the q-square comparison isomorphisms. Compose each given arrow with q at the target to obtain a scheme morphism ψ, and prove its structure-map equation by the q-square equations and the fact that g is over the limit scheme.
Use finite_pullback_hom_descent for these ψ to descend all arrows to one common stage, retaining their structure-map equations and their equality after pullback to the limit.

Use affineEtale_pullback_arrow_comparison to turn the descended scheme morphisms into arrows between the canonical affine étale base changes and comparison isomorphisms with the desired equation. Supply pullback.fst for rA and rB; their squares are IsPullback.of_hasPullback.

proof_origin.place: 0EYL and Limits 01ZM(2), read online on 2026-10-12; S2 Lean proof via simultaneous scheme-arrow descent and pullback comparison
